keyFindings.description: mutation.go:484-485 answers every re-anchor error but ErrTargetNotFound as refusedReanchor (400 INVALID_MARKDOWN, cause kept only as text). Only pmdoc/find.go:1066 (mark not allowed in this block) is the caller's markdown; the other MarkWriter.Mark guards (find.go:1042-1049: empty range, unknown mark type, attrNestingError over the stored mark's attrs), yTextRanges/yFragmentLocations errors over the scratch, and any non-NotFound finder error are server faults that would be told to the uploader as its markdown, with no ERROR log. Fix: a pmdoc sentinel (e.g. ErrMarkNotAllowed) wrapped with ErrSchema at find.go:1066; refusedReanchor only for it; every other error through documentSchemaError as before (500); a test that the sentinel marks the not-allowed refusal and no other guard (pmdoc level); narrow mutation.go:468-472 and AGENTS.md:71-73. The tree's architect asked for this mapping.

A quote moved into YAML front matter is refused for every anchor kind (yFragmentLocations sets no textblock for front matter, find.go:1206-1209; markAllowedInTextblock(_, "") is false), and the 400 reads 'not allowed in )' with an empty block name (deep review reproduced it with a comment). Name front matter in the refusal, cover front matter and every anchor kind in the changelog fragment, AGENTS.md and the INVALID_MARKDOWN row of cmd/dispatch/README.md, and add a test. The PR body's claim that comments are unaffected holds only for code blocks.
refusedReanchor's `if kind == "" { kind = mark.markType }` fallback (mutation.go:526-528) is dead: openAnchoredMarks yields only the three mapped types (marks.go:494-498).
